title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Funding Worksheet Schedule — Availability Cover
content:
**Clause.** The funding level of a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service adds the payouts expected while the deposit becomes available: for a service that sent payouts in the month ending today, a month that takes in every payout dated fewer than one whole month before today, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's, that month's payout total divided by 30 and multiplied by the tier's ACH deposit availability in business days; for a service that sent no payout in that month but has earlier payouts, its largest single payout; for any other service nothing.

| Tier | Business days before an ACH deposit can be disbursed |
|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 2 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 2 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 1 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 1 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 1 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 0 |

| Payout history of the service | Amount added to the funding level |
|---|---|
| payouts in the month ending today | the month's payout total divided by 30, multiplied by the tier's ACH availability days |
| no payout in that month, earlier payouts | the largest single payout the service has booked |
| no payout ever | nothing |

## Worked figures (hypothetical payouts)

- Payouts this month totalling 9000.00 on a tier with 2 availability days: 9000.00 divided by 30 is 300.00, multiplied by 2 is 600.00. With 1 day: 300.00. With 0 days: nothing.
- No payout this month; largest earlier payout 750.00: 750.00.
